articles.title: UEFA y Concacaf exigen más ingresos a Infantino para las federaciones
articles.standfirst: Sostienen que la reserva del máximo organismo permite un desembolso mayor para infraestructuras y desarrollo del fútbol
articles.summary: Sostienen que
articles.body: Los vicepresidente de la FIFA, entre los que se encuentra Aleksander Ceferin, presidente de la UEFA, han enviado una carta al presidente Gianni Infantino para proponerle que otorgue más fondos a las distintas Federaciones miembros. En la misiva le piden que examine qué parte de las reservas financieras acumuladas de la FIFA podrían destinarse de forma responsable y directa a sus federaciones. Según The Times, el presidente de la UEFA y el de la Concacaf, Victor Montagliani, exigen que cada Federación reciba 7,5 millones de libras. Esta iniciativa busca distribuir más de 2.000 millones de dólares de los 6.000 millones acumulados en reservas de la organización de cara al Consejo de la FIFA previsto para el próximo 15 de octubre. "La iniciativa FIFA Forward Enterprise» (FFE) se presentó a las 211 federaciones como una propuesta en virtud de la cual se vendería una participación en las competiciones de la FIFA a inversores externos con el fin de proporcionar recursos mucho mayores para el desarrollo del fútbol. Hemos examinado los estados financieros y los presupuestos publicados por la FIFA para comprobar esa premisa. Nuestro análisis plantea ahora una cuestión importante: si la operación propuesta era necesaria para proporcionar mayores recursos a las asociaciones miembro, la FIFA ya tiene capacidad para aportar recursos mucho mayores para el desarrollo del fútbol", dice la carta. La carta sostiene que la FIFA, del periodo 2023-26, va a disponer de unas reservas de aproximadamente 6.000 millones de dólares —las mayores de su historia, y "considerablemente superiores a lo necesario para sostener a la FIFA durante los años de déficit que siguen a una Copa del Mundo". Apuntan que en base a esas cifras debería poner al menos 10 millones de dólares a disposición de cada una de sus 211 asociaciones miembro durante el ciclo 2027-30 para inversiones en infraestructura y desarrollo del fútbol, "un total agregado de aproximadamente 2.100 millones de dólares". "La FIFA debe seguir siendo financieramente sólida, cumplir con sus compromisos existentes y mantener un colchón adecuado, y nuestro análisis tiene plenamente en cuenta eso. Pero la FIFA posee actualmente miles de millones de dólares en reservas acumuladas. Estos recursos pertenecen al fútbol y existen para servir al juego y a sus asociaciones. La prudencia no debería impedir un examen cuidadoso de si una parte podría liberarse de manera responsable, en la medida en que esas reservas superen las necesidades previsibles de la FIFA", añade la carta.

articles.body: El Sevilla ha facilitado la lista de 25 jugadores convocados por Luis García Plaza para el partido de mañana (21.00 horas) frente al Barcelona en el Sánchez-Pizjuán, un desafío mayúscula justo antes del parón donde los hispalenses intentarán dar la campanada al igual que ya hicieron hace poco menos de un año. articles.title: Arizona soccer can rewrite story of season with upset of No. 23 BYU
articles.summary: There’s still a lot of soccer to play, but if projections are correct, the story for Arizona soccer won’t have a happy ending. Based on games already played...
articles.body:
There's still a lot of soccer to play, but if projections are correct, the story for Arizona soccer won't have a happy ending. Based on games already played and projections for the Big 12 season, the Wildcats are expected to end up outside the top 175 in RPI *, but they can begin writing a different story when conference play starts on Friday evening.

A large part of Arizona's story is based not only on its existing win-loss-draw record of 3-4-1 but also on the opponents on its schedule. While Arizona played a top 25 team when North Carolina came to town, its opponents' projected average RPI ranking is 129 and it is not expected to have a single win over a top 50 team this season.

The opportunity to disprove that starts with BYU's visit to Mulcahy Soccer Stadium, which kicks off Arizona's Big 12 schedule. The Cougars are ranked No. 23 in the United Soccer Coaches poll. They are projected at No. 39 in RPI when selection day rolls around.

BYU is certainly capable of being upset. Utah State pulled off the 4-0 victory against the Cougars back on Sept. 10 when BYU was ranked 13th in the coaches poll. It was the Aggies' third match against a ranked Big 12 team and its only victory. It was shut out in earlier contests against Kansas and Colorado.

"I do know Utah State is a good team and well coached, and invests heavily in their soccer," Arizona head coach Becca Moros said back on Sept. 10. "It may not be a Power 4, but they may have more money than a bunch of Power 4s. So I can't really weigh in on [USU's win over BYU], but yeah, I mean, there's a lot of parity in women's soccer, a lot of good soccer players in this country. So I think that's all positive, and I think if we take care of what we can take care of to the best of our ability, we'll get good results. Will we get every result? No, but we will get good results, and I think that's what we have to focus on."

Where: Mulcahy Soccer Stadium in Tucson, Ariz.

Recent history says that Arizona can be competitive against the Cougars. Last year, the Wildcats lost to BYU in Provo by the score of 3-2. The only two Big 12 teams the Wildcats scored multiple goals against were the Cougars and Oklahoma State. They only scored in three Big 12 contests overall during a 2-8-1 conference season.

Arizona's first year in the Big 12 was much more successful. While they didn't make the NCAA Tournament, they finished 11-6-2 overall and 6-4-1 in the league on their way to a berth in the Big 12 Tournament. That run included a 2-1 win over BYU in Tucson.

Home is a good place for the Wildcats when they face the Cougars, especially in recent years. The two teams have played three times in the past decade. Arizona is 2-1 in those matchups with both wins coming in Mulcahy. Those are the only Wildcat wins in the nine-game series that stretches back to 1996.

This season, the road has been a bit more perilous for the Cougars, as well. Their loss to Utah State came in Logan. Their other loss, an upset by a Wisconsin team that has since risen to No. 14 in the polls, happened in Madison.

To grab another home win and get off to a good start in conference play, Arizona is going to have to do something it has struggled to do for the past two years, though. Namely, score.

The Wildcats have been fairly good at getting the ball into their attacking third. In their final nonconference match, they had slightly more overall possession than Pepperdine, controlling the ball 51 percent of the time. They had dramatically more possession in the attacking third, spending 40 percent of their possession in that part of the field compared to the Waves' 17 percent.

That superiority in possession in the dangerous part of the field led to a 10-4 advantage in corner kicks for Arizona. What it didn't lead to was a superiority in shots or shots on goal. Pepperdine won the shots stat 12-8 and shots on goal 5-4.

Those stats will have to be fixed if Arizona hopes to upset BYU. On the other hand, BYU could use improvements in the same areas.

While the two teams have similar offensive stats, the Cougars have played a much more difficult schedule. They have already faced five Power 4 teams plus Utah State. They went 4-1 in the matches against fellow P4 programs, including a win over then-No. 9 UCLA. Four of their opponents appear in the current poll, including both Wisconsin and USU. They are .500 against teams that are currently ranked.

North Carolina is the only ranked team Arizona has faced. The Wildcats are 0-1-1 in matches against other Power 4 teams.

Both Arizona and BYU are low-scoring teams this season, but they also don't give up a lot of goals. The Wildcats average 1.12 goals per game. The Cougars are only slightly better at 1.14 goals per game. On the other end of the field, the Wildcats are holding opponents to an identical 1.12 goals per game and the Cougars are holding theirs to 1.14 goals.

Both teams are outshooting opponents by a decent margin. Arizona takes 12.4 shots per game while giving up 8.5. The difference is less dramatic for BYU, which takes 13.3 shots per game and allows 11 by opponents.

On a per-game basis, the Wildcats put more of their shots on goal (5.25/gm) than the Cougars do (4.67/gm). Arizona puts 42.4 percent of its shots on goal compared to BYU at 34.4 percent.

However, BYU is doing a better job of limiting its opponents in this area than UA is. The Cougars have allowed opponents to take a total of 77 shots this season, but only 37.7 percent of those are on goal. The Wildcats have allowed a total of just 68 shots, but 42.6 percent of those are on goal.

The Cougars are relying on their goal-scorers to create their own opportunities more often than the Wildcats. BYU only has five assists on its eight goals this season. Arizona has eight assists on nine goals.

On a statistical basis, Arizona matches up well with BYU, albeit against an easier schedule. Can the Wildcats combine that with the homefield advantage to pull off the upset? It would be a big step towards flipping the script on the season so far.

*The official RPI has not yet been released this season. Projections and simulations in this article are based on the work of Christopher Thomas , who does yearly bracketology projections for Division I women's soccer.

articles.title: Former BVB star says Bayern Munich’s Harry Kane deserves Ballon d’Or, but it will be tough
articles.summary: Will the FC Bayern star be able to capture the elusive trophy?
articles.body:
Harry Kane 's Ballon d'Or case continues to generate plenty of discussion, and former Borussia Dortmund and Celtic midfielder Paul Lambert believes the Bayern Munich striker absolutely belongs in the conversation.

Speaking to BOYLE Sports, who offers the latest football odds , Lambert, who was part of Dortmund's 1997 Champions League-winning team and earned 40 Scotland caps during his playing career, praised Kane's extraordinary goalscoring record and the way the England captain conducts himself away from the pitch.

"If you look at Harry Kane's goalscoring record, it's been phenomenal. What I really like about Harry Kane, and I don't know him personally, is that he seems really humble. That's a great trait in any footballer. It doesn't matter how many goals he scores, he comes out and says all the right things and conducts himself really well," said Lambert. "Would he be a worthy winner? Yeah, he'd be a worthy winner. But it's so rare to win the Ballon d'Or without winning a World Cup or a Champions League.

"That's the reality of it. When you look at Rodri and players like that who are World Cup or Champions League winners, it's going to be tough. But quite rightly, he's in the conversation for it."

That last point is where the Kane debate gets particularly interesting. Kane's individual production has put him firmly among the leading candidates for the 2026 award, but Lambert points to the traditional importance of major international and European trophies when voters make their decision. Current Ballon d'Or coverage has Kane among the leading contenders after a prolific season for Bayern Munich.

For Kane, the argument remains straightforward: if the Ballon d'Or is supposed to recognize the world's best individual player, his goals, performances and overall contribution have put him squarely in that discussion.

Lambert agrees on one important point, at least: Kane has earned his place at the table.

articles.title: Five Plays: Villanova Wildcats Second Half
articles.summary: The Cards closed out the game well against Villanova last weekend. The offense got going with the run and the pass, and they continued to play mostly clean f...
articles.body:
The Cards closed out the game well against Villanova last weekend. The offense got going with the run and the pass, and they continued to play mostly clean football. The defense looked much better in coverage in the second half, though they did have a couple of plays where they had some issues with technique and assignments. Jeff Brohm got to play plenty of young guys, including some young running backs who looked very good.

Louisville scored a touchdown early in this game when they snuck Jaleel Skinner out of the backside off run action to the left. It was a pretty simple play design, but it worked, in part, because the defense keyed on the run action. You can see that even after that, no one on this defense looked for the fake. They keyed on Isaac Brown at the snap, including a safety who sprints downhill as soon as the ball is snapped.

The Cards will be able to continue to exploit this against defenses, and Jeff Brohm should focus on taking what the defense gives him with his calls and his directions to his quarterback. I don't think this is a called RPO based on how the line blocks, but it should be. Make defenses pay for ignoring the plays off of the run action. It will eventually lead to more space for the running backs as teams adjust.

I've been doing these film reviews for a long time now, and this is one of the more impressive individual plays I've clipped. AJ Green is being blocked by a tight end on this play, and he, quite literally, tosses him like a rag doll. There's not any deep analysis on this play. He just tosses the guy and then makes the tackle to end the drive.

It was later in the game, but we finally got to see the offensive line get some push in the run game. The camera change makes it hard to make out the numbers, but the interior linemen wash out the defensive line on this play, which pushes guys back into the linebackers. You can see the linebackers struggle a bit to pick up the ball, and that gives Marquis Davis a cutback lane to the third level of the defense. He needs to hold onto the ball here, but this is what it should look like for the run game.

Koen Entringer had a rough day with a blown coverage in the first quarter and a touchdown given up in the second quarter, where he was beaten in coverage. But this is where he brings real value. He is unbelievable as a physical presence in the middle of the field. He likes to punish people when he arrives at the ball, and he does it cleanly, which we all know is important.

On this play, he is playing as a "robber", which means that he is lined up as a deep safety, but he is responsible for sinking into the middle of the field to try to confuse the quarterback. The call works as Entringer meets the tight end right as he catches the ball. You can see that the quarterback leads him up the field because he thinks he has space to run. Instead, Entringer lays a textbook hit on the tight end to separate him from the ball. Ben Perry turns into a defensive lineman for some reason and can't make the interception.

It was great to see this adjustment from the defensive line. This is the same screen Nova had been running all game, and this was against the same defensive call UofL was running in the first quarter. Instead of this play going for a decent gain like it was early on, the defensive line identified the blockers, allowing them to pass through, and they hustled outside to make a tackle behind the line. Small details matter because SMU will be looking to hit them with screen passes this weekend.

This is another blown coverage from what I'm seeing. It looks like the same Cover 3 look we saw against Ole Miss. The corner at the bottom of the screen bails into a deep zone to take away the go route. The safety in the middle of the field gets depth in his zone in the middle of the field. The underneath defenders are all dropping into short and intermediate zones with their eyes on the quarterback. Then you have Jabari Mack following the receiver to his side into the middle of the field. Mark Ivey and Steve Ellis need these veteran players to be more disciplined and focused.

Worth noting that this is an absolute dime of a throw.

I always make it a point not to pick on individual players, but Mack had a rough drive. This is just basic man coverage, but his technique is poor, which leads to him getting beat badly on a go route. Mack gets hands on the receiver, which is what you want to see in press coverage, but his shoulders end up just over his toes, and the contact with the receiver then knocks him off balance. You can see that once he's just a bit off balance, the receiver ends up using his contact to push himself away from Mack, and now it's a race.

Mack doesn't win the race, and a slightly underthrown ball helps him to take the flag and stop the touchdown. At this point, I'm questioning just how much press coverage Louisville should be in. I don't know that the entire secondary can execute like they need to.

This is what physical press coverage should look like from Tayon Holloway. He lets the receiver free release, but he mirrors him while taking away any inside route. Once the receiver commits to the fade route, he gets hands on him before playing his eyes, which tell him when to turn to make a play on the ball. It's not apples to apples to the above play, but Mack could have played it the same way.

Brycen Scott gives another good example of how you can play tight man coverage and make a play on the ball. I honestly wouldn't mind seeing the corners play slightly off like Scott is here as opposed to trying to jam the receiver at the snap. He uses the sideline to his advantage very well here.

Watch how he gives the receiver a few steps so that he is in position to take away any inside route. He then allows the receiver to run himself into the sideline while angling himself to be ahead of the receiver before getting hands on him and playing his eyes. Once the receiver's eyes start tracking the ball, he gets his inside hand up to knock the ball away. They need much, much more of this.

I was really impressed with Marquise Davis in the spring, but it was mostly because of his ability to catch the ball out of the backfield and his good speed for a bigger back. They weren't tackling, so we didn't get to see stuff like this. The way he tosses off the last defender on this run blew me away. It's like watching a dad wrestle with his kids.

It's tough to make out the number, but I believe this is Dillon Smith at defensive tackle taking on a block and shutting down this run play with pure strength. He stands up the left tackle and pushes him back into the play, which ends up tripping the pulling guard, causing the running back to stumble before Trent Carter comes in to clean him up. Good stuff from a young guy who can be a nice depth option on the inside.

This is really nice to see from Marlon Harbin. The true freshman not only gets a nice gain, but he lowers his shoulder into the safety and runs right through him. Briggs Cherry's ball is also great; he leads him upfield exactly how you would want him to. I know this is garbage time, but it's always nice to see young guys make good plays like this.

Mike pointed this out at the time, but it says a lot about Harbin that so many of his teammates couldn't wait to come over and give him some love after this play. At the end of the clip, you can see coaches and players come over one after the other, including a lot of defensive veterans. This goes on for another few seconds, but I couldn't fit it in the clip. It's rare to see this type of reaction.

This is the first sack of the season for the Cards, and it was a good one. Tyler Thompson was brought in for exactly this type of play. He sets up the right tackle with a quick fake inside, followed immediately by hopping outside while using his hands to rip down on the tackle's hands. He propels himself forward with that rip move, and he has a free shot at the quarterback. They need more of this, and they need it from all of the pass rushers on the team.

articles.title: Kamario Taylor Named 'Best QB I've Seen in CFB in A Few Years' by Big Ten Coach amid Breakout Season
articles.summary: Mississippi State quarterback Kamario Taylor drew some high praise thanks to his unexpectedly strong start to the 2026 season.
articles.body:
Mississippi State quarterback Kamario Taylor drew some high praise thanks to his unexpectedly strong start to the 2026 season.

"He is the best QB I've seen in college football in a few years," said one coach from a Big Ten program, per The Athletic's Bruce Feldman . "His film is absurd. His arm talent is close to the freakiest I've seen from a college kid. It's Joe Milton but with accuracy and shot selection. He's impressively mobile for being 6'4", 230. He's got field vision. He operates from a muddy pocket often and with lots of success."

Buzz: Kiffin's Savage Goal vs. Ole Miss 😈

The coach went on to quip that Taylor is "gonna look awesome" on the Miami Hurricanes in 2027, given that school's recent habit of poaching productive QBs through the portal.

Taylor has gone 38-of-56 for 581 yards and seven touchdowns through Mississippi State's two wins. In the 38-13 victory over Minnesota, he also ran for 86 yards.

In conversations around the best quarterbacks, Taylor wasn't really on many people's radars coming into the year. He was a 4-star recruit but far overshadowed by Bryce Underwood and Keelon Russell within his high school class. He was limited to backup duty behind Blake Shapen as a true freshman as well.

His breakout won't be a surprise to those inside the Bulldogs locker room, though.

"Even as a freshman, you'd go into the cafeteria and the senior defensive linemen would be sitting with him," one source told CBS Sports' Matt Zenitz . "He just has that aura with him to where guys are just drawn to him."

We're soon about to discover whether Taylor is the real deal. Mississippi State hits the road to play South Carolina on Saturday and then faces off with No. 20 Missouri, No. 10 Alabama, No. 7 LSU, No. 24 Oklahoma and No. 1 Texas in succession.

If Taylor is still playing at an efficient clip through October, NFL scouts and rival coaching staffs will be taking notice.

articles.title: El Celta realizará una primera ampliación de capital de 10 millones para su proyecto Celta360
articles.standfirst: El último ejercicio se cerró con unas pérdidas de 7’7 millones
articles.summary: El último ejercicio se cerró con unas pérdidas de 7’7 millones
articles.body: El Celta realizará una ampliación de capital 10 millones, ampliable a 20, para su proyecto Celta360. La operación, sujeta todavía a la aprobación de la Junta General de Accionistas, contempla una primera ampliación preferente a favor de los accionistas actuales. La estructura busca contener el coste financiero, limitar el endeudamiento y preservar la sostenibilidad económica del proyecto y del Celta, manteniendo el actual control accionarial El Consejo de Administración del Celta propondrá a la próxima Junta General de Accionistas una primera ampliación de capital destinada a contribuir a la financiación de Celta360. La operación global combina distintas fórmulas de financiación y aportación de capital para avanzar en uno de los proyectos más estratégicos de la entidad celeste. La operación contempla la posible incorporación de un nuevo accionista minoritario únicamente en el supuesto de que los accionistas actuales no ejerzan su derecho de suscripción y no suscriban la totalidad de la ampliación tras dicho periodo preferente, manteniéndose en todo caso el actual control accionarial del Celta. El proyecto Celta360 se encuentra actualmente en su segunda fase de construcción, con la previsión de que los nuevos edificios del complejo entren en funcionamiento a finales del verano de 2027. La financiación permitirá avanzar en el desarrollo de una infraestructura concebida para convertirse en un referente deportivo y de actividad empresarial en Galicia y el norte de Portugal, según señalan desde el club.. Igualmente afirman: “Celta360 es uno de los proyectos más estratégicos del club y combina el desarrollo deportivo con la generación de nuevas oportunidades de negocio. Su objetivo es ampliar las bases de crecimiento del Celta, fortalecer su política de cantera y contribuir a su solidez económica a largo plazo”. La ampliación de capital constituye uno de los componentes de la estructura de financiación de hasta 125 millones de euros prevista para Celta360. Por lo demás, en la Junta General de Accionistas del próximo 20 de octubre a las 19:00, el club presentará un récord histórico de facturación, superando por primera vez la cifra de 100 millones de euros y acabando en 106,2 de facturación consolidada frente los 73,9 millones del ejercicio anterior. La inversión en plantilla responde a la política de crecimiento del club y avalada por LaLiga. El gasto de personal deportivo sube un 13%. Este incremento viene derivado de mejoras salariales a jugadores y cuerpo técnico del primer equipo, así como primas asociadas a logros deportivos en el caso del primer equipo y filial. Se han realizado inversiones en jugadores por importe de 17,7 millones frente a los 12,7 millones de la temporada anterior. Derivado de esta política de inversión y mantenimiento de jugadores, el valor de mercado de la plantilla según Transfermark se ha incrementado de 130 a 173 millones, lo que supone un incremento del 33% en una única temporada. La pérdida contable tiene una explicación basada en la política de no necesidad de venta inmediata, sino en la búsqueda del beneficio mediante la generación de ingresos asociados a rendimiento deportivo y de otras líneas de negocio. A cierre de ejercicio a 30 de junio de 2026, el Celta presenta perdidas, después de impuestos, por importe de 7,7 millones de euros frente a los 8,6 millones del ejercicio anterior. Según el club, se mantiene una posición solida de tesorería, con importe superior a 12,2 millones de euros y la no existencia de deuda alguna con entidades financieras al igual que en el ejercicio anterior, pese a no haberse realizado ventas significativas en el último ejercicio.

articles.summary: El extremo sólo se perderá el duelo directo ante el Mallorca, mientras que el serbio tampoco podrá estar ante el Burgos
articles.body: El primer parón internacional de la temporada ya condiciona la planificación de la UD Almería, que tendrá que afrontar las próximas jornadas de liga con algunas ausencias. A pesar de la interrupción de las principales competiciones, la Segunda División mantiene su calendario y los equipos deben adaptarse a las convocatorias de sus futbolistas. Una de las bajas más importantes será la de Stefan Dzodic. El centrocampista rojiblanco ha recibido la llamada de la selección absoluta de Serbia por primera vez, después de haberse consolidado como uno de los referentes de la sub-21, de la que recientemente asumió la capitanía. Dzodic se incorporará a la concentración dirigida por Veljko Paunović y tendrá por delante varios compromisos internacionales. Esta convocatoria tendrá un efecto directo sobre el Almería, ya que el futbolista no podrá participar en los encuentros frente al Mallorca, previsto para el 27 de septiembre, y el Burgos, que se disputará el 3 de octubre. Serbia disputará cuatro compromisos de la Nations League: ante Grecia, el 24 de septiembre; Países Bajos, el 27 de septiembre y el 4 de octubre; y Alemania, el 1 de octubre. Otro futbolista que deberá abandonar temporalmente la disciplina rojiblanca es Brian Cipenga. El extremo ha sido incluido en la convocatoria de la República Democrática del Congo para los primeros partidos de clasificación para la próxima Copa África que se disputará en verano de 2027. Su selección se enfrentará a Guinea Ecuatorial y Zimbabue, por lo que el jugador no estará disponible para el choque ante el Mallorca. La situación de Cipenga, sin embargo, será diferente para el siguiente compromiso liguero. El atacante no figura en la segunda lista de convocados para los amistosos que la selección congoleña disputará en Sudáfrica ante Uganda, por lo que podrá estar a disposición de García Pimienta para recibir al Burgos en casa. En el apartado de buenas noticias aparece Áron Yaakobishvili. El guardameta del Almería no ha sido convocado por Hungría para esta ventana internacional, pese a los compromisos que afrontará el combinado magiar, por lo que permanecerá trabajando con el equipo. También queda pendiente la situación de Quim Junyent. El futbolista no ha entrado en la convocatoria de la selección española sub-21, aunque podría recibir una llamada de la sub-20 para el amistoso que España disputará contra México el 30 de septiembre en Ceuta. En cualquier caso, García Pimienta ya ha señalado que una posible convocatoria no impediría que el jugador participase con el Almería en sus compromisos de Liga. Pimienta ha pedido esta misma mañana en sala de prensa que “la liga se pare porque muchos jugadores de Segunda División acaban yendo a las convocatorias internacionales y no debería de ser así”.

articles.title: Ole Miss' Pete Golding Reveals Lane Kiffin Text About Sam Leavitt, LSU Injury Report in New Video
articles.summary: LSU coach Lane Kiffin reached out to Ole Miss' Pete Golding prior publishing an injury report that listed quarterback Sam Leavitt as doubtful for Saturday's game.
articles.body:
LSU coach Lane Kiffin reached out to Ole Miss' Pete Golding prior publishing an injury report that listed quarterback Sam Leavitt as doubtful for Saturday's game.

"I got the text before the report went out like from Lane 'Hey, our quarterback's out,'" Golding said Friday on The Pat McAfee Show . "I'm like, 'Yeah buddy, I bet he is. I've been around here a lot of Wednesdays with you, man, for three and a half years.'"

Buzz: Kiffin's Savage Goal vs. Ole Miss 😈

LSU upgraded Leavitt to questionable, so the signs appear to be pointing toward him suiting up against the Rebels.

The initial inclusion of the junior signal-caller came as a surprise because he didn't show any signs of getting injured in LSU's 45-14 victory over Louisiana Tech. He went 25-of-38 for 344 yards, one touchdown and three interceptions while running for 22 yards and three scores.

ESPN's Pete Thamel reported Thursday that "no one on the Ole Miss staff is convinced" that Leavitt will actually miss Saturday's highly anticipated clash. He reportedly practiced with the team hours later, justifying the general skepticism from Rebels coaches.

ESPN's Alex Scarborough noted the SEC prohibits using the injury report in a way that's intended to gain a competitive advantage. A player who's doubtful is "unlikely to play due to significant concerns."

Proving intent in this case could prove tricky because Leavitt might have a genuine injury that's leaving him at less than 100 percent but one not serious enough to jeopardize his availability.

This is all adding another subplot to a matchup that wasn't lacking in storylines.

Golding played down having any animosity toward Kiffin, who left Ole Miss for LSU ahead of the College Football Playoff:

Rebels fans won't be so quick to forgive. They've had Sept. 19 circled on their calendars for months.

Creating all this intrigue around Leavitt is another way Kiffin will have drawn the ire of those in Oxford.

articles.title: Junta Directiva el lunes y luz verde al plan 'De la Fuente 2032'
articles.standfirst: Es el paso que falta para anunciar formalmente la renovación
articles.summary: Es el paso que falta para anunciar formalmente la renovación
articles.body: Con muchos temas en la rueda de prensa, De la Fuente sabía que uno que saldría seguro sería el de su renovación. Pero no quiso ser él quien diera luz verde al acuerdo. “Me vais a permitir que yo no hable de eso y que lo anuncie la Federación cuando lo tenga que anunciar”, aseguró. Todo está acordado para alargar su etapa hasta 2032. Pero falta que ese acuerdo pase por la Junta directiva de la Federación. Para eso se ha convocado para el lunes. Pasado ese paso, obligado, se anunciará que De la Fuente será el seleccionado español hasta que acabe la Euro de 2032, la que se jugará en Italia y Turquía. El acuerdo de la renovación del contrato de un seleccionadro debe adoptarse a través de la Junta Directiva de la Federación, no únicamente por su presidente. Es un momento novedoso en la selección. Nunca antes se ha renovado a un seleccionador con un contrato tan largo. La norma de la casa siempre fue ir de fase final a fase final. Ahora, Rafael Louzán cambia el paso y propondrá a la Junta un contrato con De la Fuente en cuyo camino aparece el Mundial de 2030 y la Euro de 2032, además de las Ligas de las Naciones de 2027 y 2029. En 2032, De la Fuente cumplirá una década al frente de la selección. Fue nombrado en diciembre de 2022. Su debut llegó en marzo del año siguiente. Ahora mismo su cuenta con España está en 50 partidos. Es el sexto seleccionador con más recorrido. Por delante tiene a Del Bosque (114), Kubala (68), Clemente (62), Miguel Muñoz (60) y Luis Aragonés (54). En lo que es único es en el listado de títulos con la selección: Liga de las Naciones de 2023, Eurocopa de 2024 y Mundial de 2026.

articles.title: Josep Martínez: un alegrón en un año durísimo
articles.standfirst: Necesitó ayuda psicológica tras el accidente en Milan en el que murió un anciano y su padre sufre una enfermedad sin solución
articles.summary: Necesitó ayuda psicológica tras el accidente en Milan en el que murió un anciano y su padre sufre una enfermedad sin solución
articles.body: Josep Martínez se llevó en la mañana del viernes una enorme alegría. Luis de la Fuente nombró al portero del Inter después de Unai Simón y David Raya. Regresa a la selección, un mundo que no toca desde el 9 de junio de 2021. Entonces, como Cucurella o Zubimendi debutó con la absoluta en aquel peculiar partido ante Lituania. Jugaba en el RB Leipzig. El año no ha sido fácil para el valenciano de Alzira. En octubre pasado, se vio involucrado en un trágico accidente que le costó la vida a Paolo Saibene, de 81 años. Según la reconstrucción del siniestro, la víctima sufrió un colapso que le hizo perder el control de su silla eléctrica e invadir el carril por el que circulaba el español. Una enorme tragedia de la que nada tuvo culpa, pero que, lógicamente, le afectó muchísimo Necesitió ayuda de un psicólogo, al margen del calor de su familia y de todo el Inter. "Conté con el apoyo de mis compañeros, mi familia y mis amigos. Un profesional también me brindó su ayuda. Pero no hay secretos: cuando ocurre una tragedia así, uno se siente mal, y es normal. Fue un momento difícil. Luego, con el tiempo, logré seguir adelante", explicó en La Gazzetta dello Sport. A esa tragedia se sumó otra tremenda situación personal que desveló, tras saberse que iba con la selección, su madre en Á Punt Radio, en el programa, El Partit de la Una: el padre de Josep se encuentra en una fase sin solución de una enfermedad. Pero este viernes se llevó una monumental alegría con la lista de España y la presencia de su hijo en ella.

articles.title: Lane Kiffin Gets Students to Heckle LSU Players in Trending Video as Prep for Ole Miss Rivalry Game
articles.summary: LSU coach Lane Kiffin is preparing his team for a rowdy Ole Miss crowd during his Saturday return to Oxford.
articles.body:
LSU coach Lane Kiffin is preparing his team for a rowdy Ole Miss crowd during his Saturday return to Oxford.

ESPN's Pat McAfee shared a video Friday (1:11:30 mark of the video below) of Kiffin and his players walking through a gauntlet of LSU students pretending to heckle them.

Buzz: Kiffin's Savage Goal vs. Ole Miss 😈

No. 7 LSU is set to face No. 8 Ole Miss for the first time since Kiffin departed the program Saturday at 7:30 p.m. ET.

Kiffin led Ole Miss to an 11-1 record and the program's first playoff berth before accepting the head coaching job at LSU, leading to him and the Rebels parting ways before the College Football Playoff.

Pete Golding led Ole Miss to the CFP semifinal before suffering an elimination loss to Miami.

Ole Miss has reportedly been preparing for the upcoming reunion with their former coach by instituting new safety measures ahead of Saturday's game.

The athletics programs told students Thursday people wearing LSU colors will not be allowed into the Ole Miss student section, per Tyler Komis .

The Mississippi Department of Public Safety has also announced an increase in law enforcement presence around Oxford ahead of the game.

Kiffin told reporters Monday he had been preparing his players for the matchup by telling him the attention was directed toward him rather than them.

"I told the players today, 'You don't have anything to worry about as far as attention on you all week and everything,'" Kiffin said earlier this week. "'There's just going to be so much attention, hatred, everything on me.' I said, 'You just get to go play.'"

Both Ole Miss and LSU have started out the season with two straight wins, although Tigers quarterback Sam Leavitt stumbled early in last weekend's matchup against Louisiana Tech before recovering to lead his team to a blowout victory.

Kiffin will now look to bounce back with a revenge victory against a program he publicly criticized for not letting him continue coaching during last winter's CFP run.

articles.title: Olise se suma a la fiesta de Kane en la tremenda goleada del Bayern
articles.standfirst: El francés con un hat-trick y el inglés con un doblete, que suma ya 101 goles en Bundesliga, arrollan al Union Berlin (7-0)
articles.summary: El francés con un hat-trick y el inglés con un doblete, que suma ya 101 goles en Bundesliga, arrollan al Union Berlin (7-0)
articles.body: El Bayern no quería cometer ningún tropiezo más en la Bundesliga. Por eso, se puso en modo apisonadora, y dejó el partido resuelto en los primeros 45 minutos, con los goles de Musiala, Kane y Olise. En la segunda mitad, otra vez Kane, Saibari y de nuevo Olise, esta vez por partida doble, completaron la goleada al Union Berlin. El equipo de Kompany salió a por los tres puntos desde el comienzo. Se hizo dueño del balón y obligó al Union Berlin a meterse en su área. Olise comenzó probando varias veces a Ronnow. Sin embargo, el primero llegó por medio de Musiala. Encontró Davies al '10' en el borde del área. Y Jamal no se lo pensó y sacó un zapatazo a la escuadra más alejada para poner el primero. Pudo llegar el segundo tras un remate en plancha de Tah, pero el guardameta del Union Berlin realizó una gran parada. Sin embargo, no iba a poder mantener a los suyos ante una máquina de hacer goles. Olise, que llevaba el balón pegado al pie, le sacó un penalti a Rothe. Kane se encargó de transformarlo con un gran lanzamiento cruzado, y alcanzó así los 100 goles en Bundesliga. Antes del descanso, Olise iba a hacer el suyo y poner la puntilla al Union Berlin. Dejó Musiala de cara para el francés, que mandó un zapatazo a la escuadra más cercana. Sin embargo, los visitantes no habían ido al Allianz para regalar los puntos. Tras volver de los vestuarios, Neuer tuvo que intervenir dos veces seguidas para mantener su portería a cero. A pesar de los dos intentos, fue un espejismo. Olise, con un gran centro, encontró a Kane. El inglés, con un sutil remate de cabeza, mandó el balón al fondo de la red y redujo a cenizas las esperanzas del Union Berlin por remontar. El Union Berlin no podía hacer otra cosa que defenderse. Pero el Bayern quería más y más. Y tras una gran jugada de Saibari en la que se giró, se metió en el área y sacó un disparo al primer palo, el Bayern puso el quinto. Y el castigo todavía no había terminado. Bischof envió un pase largo a Olise que se encontraba solo. Regateó a Ronnow y con la portería vacía mandó el balón al fondo de la red tras tocar en el palo. No era suficiente para el francés, que quería llevarse el balón. Tan solo tres minutos después, recibió el balón en la frontal y volvió a penetrar la meta de Ronnow con un disparo cruzado a la escuadra. El Bayern fue una máquina que atropelló sin piedad al Union Berlin.

articles.title: Man United fighting with fierce rivals to land “gifted” playmaker who can transform Michael Carrick’s attack
articles.summary: 1 Manchester United’s defence has let Michael Carrick down this season, but the attack is not devoid of blame.The front four failed to break down Manchester...
articles.body:
Manchester United's defence has let Michael Carrick down this season, but the attack is not devoid of blame.

The front four failed to break down Manchester City despite them being down to 10 men for over 75 minutes.

The number of chances spurned is another concern, with Marcus Rashford and Bryan Mbeumo guilty of missing glorious chances to turn the game around against Brighton and City.

This is exactly why the head coach wanted to bring in another attacking force in the summer, but INEOS failed to move on the ineffective Joshua Zirkzee , which meant an attacking addition never materialised.

But the co-owners seem to have realised their mistake and as per Fussball News , the Red Devils are looking to sign Ibrahim Maza from Bayer Leverkusen .

The 20-year-old is primarily an attacking midfielder, but can also play out wide on either flank or even as a central midfielder.

Such versatility would be a huge asset for the 20-time English league champions, with the Algerian netting five goals last season and registering seven assists.

The Berlin-born attacker has started the new season in red-hot fashion as well, netting once and providing two assists already.

United have sent scouts to watch the " gifted " playmaker but they will not have it easy given the presence of Manchester City, Arsenal and Atletico Madrid in the race.

"Ibrahim Maza has quickly attracted the attention of numerous top European clubs while playing for Bayer Leverkusen. The 20-year-old is now being scouted by several heavyweights from England and Spain. The Premier League, in particular, has its eye on the Algerian international .

"According to information from fussball-news.de, Arsenal, Manchester City, and Manchester United are closely monitoring Maza's development. Atlético Madrid is also interested in the attacking midfielder. City and Atlético are reportedly already in contact with the player's representatives to stay informed about his progress and situation at Leverkusen."

Leverkusen have Ibrahim Maza tied down until 2030, so they are in no hurry to sell. They signed the Algerian international for around £10 million.

The German club are looking to earn as much as £60 million from his sale in the future plus a sell-on clause and other add-ons. Premier League clubs should have no problem paying such a fee, but whether United can afford such a splurge is not yet clear.

They have plans of revamping the backline next summer, so it remains to be seen how much they can spare to strengthen the attack. INEOS' Premier League-proven policy could prove to be another hindrance.

articles.title: A Rakan Al-Thani, retenido en Alemania, le esperan en España: se piden 14 años de prisión
articles.standfirst: Fue detenido el pasado 12 de septiembre
articles.summary: Fue detenido el pasado 12 de septiembre
articles.body: Rakan Al-Thani continúa en una prisión de Baviera después de ser detenido el pasado 12 de septiembre en el aeropuerto de Múnich. El hijo de Abdullah Al-Thani fue localizado cuando se disponía a abandonar Alemania en un vuelo con destino a Doha (Catar), momento en el que las autoridades activaron la Orden Europea de Detención y Entrega solicitada por la Justicia española. Desde entonces permanece bajo custodia alemana a la espera de que se complete el procedimiento para su extradición a España. Según publica el diario alemán Der Spiegel, el juzgado de Málaga encargado de la causa ya ha solicitado la traducción al alemán de la euroorden, un paso necesario para que la Justicia germana pueda continuar con los trámites de entrega. Rakan Al-Thani está siendo investigado dentro de la causa judicial abierta por la gestión del Málaga CF durante el periodo en el que el club estuvo bajo control de la familia catarí. El hijo del jeque formó parte del Consejo de Administración de la entidad durante aquellos años y figura entre las personas afectadas por el procedimiento. Junto a Rakan, la investigación alcanza también a su padre, Abdullah Al-Thani, y a sus hermanos Nasser y Nayef, además de a otros antiguos dirigentes relacionados con el Málaga. De acuerdo con la documentación judicial citada por WELT, a Rakan se le atribuyen presuntamente delitos de apropiación indebida, administración desleal, falsedad documental y estafa. La Fiscalía solicita, según esta misma información, penas que alcanzan los 14 años y medio de prisión para los miembros de la familia Al-Thani incluidos en la causa. Se trata de acusaciones que deberán ser dirimidas durante el procedimiento judicial y que no implican una condena firme contra Rakan Al-Thani.

articles.title: Man City 4-2 Liverpool: Lauren Hemp double bookends victory as WSL champions maintain 100 per cent record
articles.summary: Report and free match highlights as Lauren Hemp, Khadija 'Bunny' Shaw and a Grace Fisk own goal maintain Man City's 100 per cent record at the start of the WSL season; Liverpool matched them for much of the game with Alice Bergstrom and Vivian Endermann scoring in the first half
articles.body:
But up until the 90th minute, that record and their 13-match winning run at the Joie Stadium were in serious jeopardy. Man City had to fight back to equalise in the first half before some late errors from Liverpool were taken advantage of.

An own goal from Reds captain Grace Fisk put the hosts 3-2 ahead as five minutes of added time were shown. Sensing a draw in the offing, Liverpool committed too many bodies forward, allowing the electric Hemp to speed down the field and slot home past former team-mate Khiara Keating.

The England international had made it a perfect start for the hosts too when she finished off a fine team move for her first goal since November.

But Liverpool responded brilliantly and took a deserved lead. A defensive mix-up allowed Alice Bergstrom to fire home, before Vivien Endemann - who set up the first goal - volleyed in a wonderful effort that fizzed through Ayaka Yamashita's outstretched hand.

Khadija 'Bunny' Shaw's early play for a third successive Golden Boot continued too as she scored her fourth WSL goal of the season to level. Keating spilled a save from Hemp's initial shot with Shaw there to poke home from close range.

It demonstrated once again why keeping Shaw at the club was Man City's best business of the summer.

In a game where errors decided the outcome, it was Man City who came off the better and extended their lead at the top of the table to five points ahead of the remaining games this weekend. Liverpool, meanwhile, remain third with four points.

Liverpool show how far they have come in a year

Analysis from Sky Sports' Charlotte Marsh:

"It may have been defeat for Liverpool, but they pushed the WSL champions all the way on their own turf. Very few have been able to do that, demonstrated by Man City's record-equalling winning run at the Joie Stadium.

"This is a very different Liverpool from a year ago. The club overall were dealing with unimaginable loss, with the women's team losing two icons in a short space of time in former boss Matt Beard and kitman Jon Humble.

"Then there were a string of injuries that continued to hamper the Reds progress under new boss Gareth Taylor. But the club, rightly, stuck with their man and their good start to this season is just a continued progression of a turnaround that began in the new year.

"The three performances so far is also a testament to the work over the summer. Endermann did not look like a player with only a handful of WSL games under her belt - she looked like a veteran - and caused real issues for the Man City defence, alongside Beta Olsson and Bergstrom. A super arrival from Wolfsburg.

"For large parts of the 90 minutes, Liverpool pressed better, made better decisions and had more confidence and determination to win.

"While some late slips - perhaps disproving the point of making better decisions - were their downfall, Taylor will be pleased with how his team performed with an annus horribilis firmly put to bed.

"It took Liverpool 12 games to reach four points last year. They have already hit that mark and if they keep going as they are, can even start thinking of a top-half finish - or more."

13: GOAL! A wonderful team move is finished by Hemp for her first goal of the season.

19: GOAL! A mix-up at the back from Man City allows Bergstrom to slot home.

28: GOAL! After a period of sustained pressure, Liverpool go ahead. Endermann's effort from close range goes through the hands of Yamashita.

39: POST! Shaw hits the woodwork as Man City search for a late first-half equaliser.

45+2: GOAL! A spill from Keating is turned home by Shaw from close range.

60: SAVE! Keating is needed to turn a Shaw effort over the bar.

90: GOAL! A horrible own-goal from Fisk puts Man City back in front.

90+5: GOAL! A breakaway from Hemp sees her slot easily past Keating to wrap up Man City's win.
